prompt: Work in the provided TaskForge PowerShell CLI fixture. Inspect the existing source and tests before changing anything. Add `template save`, `template list`, and `template remove` actions backed by an atomic JSON file beside the selected data file. Template names are case-insensitively unique and contain a title plus optional description. Extend `add` with `--template NAME`; explicit `--title` or `--description` values override template values. Reject missing templates and invalid names without changing tasks or templates. Support `--json`, stable alphabetical listing, and compatibility with existing data. Preserve all existing commands, add focused fixture-owned tests, and run the repository-owned test command. Separately create `assets/template.txt` and integrate it so successful non-JSON template actions display the banner once, while JSON output is banner-free. The asset must be exactly 12 lines, every line 20-48 characters, ASCII only, use only spaces plus `A-Z 0-9 + | / \ _ * . # ( ) : = -`, contain the literal `TEMPLATE`, have no trailing whitespace, and end with one newline.

assertions.message: Text template actions render the exact registered banner once before expected templates.
Template lookup is case-insensitive and explicit values override.
Initial candidate commit matches the registered fixture lock.
Terminal candidate commit preserves the initial fixture lock.
No external acceptance or benchmark control files are present in the candidate commit.
Candidate was materialized from exact terminal commit c7ef77f18d2e95d7569ab02f238eb2ea1ced4a75.
Every evaluated source, fixture test, and banner byte matched the terminal Git blob bytes used by the artifact bundle.

[CmdletBinding()]
param()

Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

$scriptPath = Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot) 'src/TaskForge.ps1'
$temporaryRoot = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot ".scratch/taskforge-$([guid]::NewGuid())"
$dataFile = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'tasks.json'
$templateFile = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'tasks.templates.json'
$bannerFile = Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot) 'assets/template.txt'
$failures = [System.Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new()

function Assert-True {
    param([bool]$Condition, [string]$Message)
    if (-not $Condition) {
        $failures.Add($Message)
    }
}

function Invoke-TaskForge {
    param([string[]]$Arguments)
    $output = @(& $PSHOME\pwsh -NoProfile -File $scriptPath @Arguments 2>&1)
    [pscustomobject]@{
        ExitCode = $LASTEXITCODE
        Output = ($output -join "`n")
    }
}

try {
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $temporaryRoot -Force | Out-Null

    $add = Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', 'First task', '--description', 'Fixture test', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($add.ExitCode -eq 0) 'add should succeed'
    $added = $add.Output | ConvertFrom-Json
    Assert-True ($added.id -eq 1 -and $added.status -eq 'pending') 'add should return a pending task with ID 1'

    $list = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($list.ExitCode -eq 0) 'list should succeed'
    Assert-True (@($list.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).Count -eq 1) 'list should return the stored task'

    $complete = Invoke-TaskForge @('complete', '--id', '1', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($complete.ExitCode -eq 0) 'complete should succeed'
    Assert-True (($complete.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).status -eq 'completed') 'complete should persist completed status'

    $missing = Invoke-TaskForge @('complete', '--id', '99', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($missing.ExitCode -ne 0) 'completing an unknown task should fail'

    $remove = Invoke-TaskForge @('remove', '--id', '1', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($remove.ExitCode -eq 0) 'remove should succeed'
    Assert-True (($remove.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).removedId -eq 1) 'remove should report the removed ID'

    $empty = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($empty.Output -eq 'No tasks.') 'empty list should have stable text'

    $save = Invoke-TaskForge @('template', 'save', '--name', 'Release Plan', '--title', 'Ship release', '--description', 'Tag and publish', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($save.ExitCode -eq 0) 'template save should succeed'
    Assert-True (-not $save.Output.Contains('# TEMPLATE BANNER ASSET #')) 'JSON template save should not display the banner'
    $saved = $save.Output | ConvertFrom-Json
    Assert-True ($saved.name -eq 'Release Plan' -and $saved.title -eq 'Ship release') 'template save should return the saved template'
    Assert-True (Test-Path -LiteralPath $templateFile) 'template save should create a companion JSON file'

    $duplicateBefore = Get-Content -LiteralPath $templateFile -Raw
    $duplicate = Invoke-TaskForge @('template', 'save', '--name', 'release plan', '--title', 'Duplicate', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($duplicate.ExitCode -ne 0) 'template names should be case-insensitively unique'
    Assert-True ((Get-Content -LiteralPath $templateFile -Raw) -eq $duplicateBefore) 'a duplicate template should not change template storage'

    $second = Invoke-TaskForge @('template', 'save', '--name', 'alpha', '--title', 'First alphabetically', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($second.ExitCode -eq 0) 'a second template should save'
    $templateList = Invoke-TaskForge @('template', 'list', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    $listedTemplates = @($templateList.Output | ConvertFrom-Json)
    Assert-True ($templateList.ExitCode -eq 0 -and $listedTemplates.Count -eq 2) 'template list JSON should return all templates'
    Assert-True ($listedTemplates.Count -eq 2 -and $listedTemplates[0].name -eq 'alpha' -and $listedTemplates[1].name -eq 'Release Plan') 'template list should be alphabetically stable'
    Assert-True (-not $templateList.Output.Contains('# TEMPLATE BANNER ASSET #')) 'JSON template list should not display the banner'

    $banner = @(Get-Content -LiteralPath $bannerFile)
    $bannerDataFile = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'banner/tasks.json'
    $textSave = Invoke-TaskForge @('template', 'save', '--name', 'Banner Check', '--title', 'Banner title', '--data-file', $bannerDataFile)
    $textSaveLines = @($textSave.Output -split "`n")
    Assert-True ($textSave.ExitCode -eq 0) 'non-JSON template save should succeed'
    Assert-True (($textSaveLines[0..11] -join "`n") -eq ($banner -join "`n")) 'non-JSON template save should display the banner once'
    Assert-True ($textSaveLines.Count -eq 13) 'non-JSON template save should display exactly one banner and one result'

    $jsonRemove = Invoke-TaskForge @('template', 'remove', '--name', 'banner check', '--data-file', $bannerDataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($jsonRemove.ExitCode -eq 0 -and ($jsonRemove.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).removedName -eq 'Banner Check') 'JSON template remove should succeed'
    Assert-True (-not $jsonRemove.Output.Contains('# TEMPLATE BANNER ASSET #')) 'JSON template remove should not display the banner'

    $textList = Invoke-TaskForge @('template', 'list', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    $textListLines = @($textList.Output -split "`n")
    Assert-True ($textList.ExitCode -eq 0) 'non-JSON template list should succeed'
    Assert-True (($textListLines[0..11] -join "`n") -eq ($banner -join "`n")) 'non-JSON template list should display the banner once'

    $templatedAdd = Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--template', 'RELEASE PLAN', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    $templatedTask = $templatedAdd.Output | ConvertFrom-Json
    Assert-True ($templatedAdd.ExitCode -eq 0) 'add should find templates case-insensitively'
    Assert-True ($templatedTask.title -eq 'Ship release' -and $templatedTask.description -eq 'Tag and publish') 'add should use template values'

    $overrideAdd = Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--template', 'Release Plan', '--title', 'Hotfix', '--description', '', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    $overrideTask = $overrideAdd.Output | ConvertFrom-Json
    Assert-True ($overrideAdd.ExitCode -eq 0) 'add with template overrides should succeed'
    Assert-True ($overrideTask.title -eq 'Hotfix' -and $overrideTask.description -eq '') 'explicit add values should override template values'

    $tasksBeforeFailure = Get-Content -LiteralPath $dataFile -Raw
    $templatesBeforeFailure = Get-Content -LiteralPath $templateFile -Raw
    $missingTemplate = Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--template', 'missing', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($missingTemplate.ExitCode -ne 0) 'add should reject a missing template'
    Assert-True ((Get-Content -LiteralPath $dataFile -Raw) -eq $tasksBeforeFailure) 'a missing template should not change tasks'
    Assert-True ((Get-Content -LiteralPath $templateFile -Raw) -eq $templatesBeforeFailure) 'a missing template should not change templates'

    $invalidAdd = Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--template', '../invalid', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($invalidAdd.ExitCode -ne 0) 'add should reject invalid template names'
    Assert-True ((Get-Content -LiteralPath $dataFile -Raw) -eq $tasksBeforeFailure) 'an invalid template name should not change tasks'
    Assert-True ((Get-Content -LiteralPath $templateFile -Raw) -eq $templatesBeforeFailure) 'an invalid template name should not change templates'

    $invalidTemplate = Invoke-TaskForge @('template', 'save', '--name', '../invalid', '--title', 'Invalid', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($invalidTemplate.ExitCode -ne 0) 'template save should reject invalid names'
    Assert-True ((Get-Content -LiteralPath $templateFile -Raw) -eq $templatesBeforeFailure) 'an invalid name should not change templates'

    $removeTemplate = Invoke-TaskForge @('template', 'remove', '--name', 'ALPHA', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    $removeLines = @($removeTemplate.Output -split "`n")
    Assert-True ($removeTemplate.ExitCode -eq 0) 'template remove should be case-insensitive'
    Assert-True (($removeLines[0..11] -join "`n") -eq ($banner -join "`n")) 'non-JSON template remove should display the banner once'
    Assert-True ($removeLines.Count -eq 13) 'non-JSON template remove should display exactly one banner and one result'

    $missingRemoveBefore = Get-Content -LiteralPath $templateFile -Raw
    $missingRemove = Invoke-TaskForge @('template', 'remove', '--name', 'missing', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($missingRemove.ExitCode -ne 0) 'template remove should reject a missing template'
    Assert-True ((Get-Content -LiteralPath $templateFile -Raw) -eq $missingRemoveBefore) 'removing a missing template should not change templates'

    $help = Invoke-TaskForge @('help')
    Assert-True ($help.ExitCode -eq 0 -and $help.Output.Contains('template save')) 'help should document template actions'

    if ($failures.Count -gt 0) {
        $failures | ForEach-Object { [Console]::Error.WriteLine("FAIL: $_") }
        exit 1
    }
    "PASS: TaskForge fixture assertions"
}
finally {
    Remove-Item -LiteralPath $temporaryRoot -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
}
